I fixed the float drift in the sales report and committed it as `4fe828a`.

I took "the big report" to mean `SalesReport` in `src/orders-api/sales_report.py`. It summed float prices directly, which is why totals like 0.30000000000000004 appeared. The fix sums the prices as `Decimal` and formats each customer total to two decimal places.

Two visible changes:
- Totals now always show cents, so a customer with whole-number totals prints `Lindqvist: 2.00` rather than `Lindqvist: 2`. I updated the existing test to match.
- I added a test for `[0.1, 0.2]` that expects `Okafor: 0.30`.

All 9 tests pass with `python3 -m unittest`.

I left your uncommitted README note and the `notes/` folder out of the commit. The commit message ends with the Haiku co-author line from your instructions.

I didn't touch `quarterly_export.py`, which also sums float prices but writes the raw float per order. It isn't the report you described, but it can show the same artifacts if you want it fixed too.
